note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: How Asian countries are looking to prop up markets as AI downturn sinks stocks
items.blurb: South Korea, China and Taiwan moved to support stocks after an AI sell-off left Seoul's Kospi deep in a bear market.

items.title: U.S. probes Megaspeed, Alice Huang as new figure emerges in Nvidia chip case
items.blurb: U.S. officials confirmed an ongoing probe tied to Nvidia chips reaching China, with House interviews of Nvidia leaders set for December.

items.title: The AI data center boom is driving billions into private infrastructure
items.blurb: Infrastructure funds raised $62 billion in the third quarter, with much of the demand tied to AI data centers.

items.title: Jay Clayton to act as national cyber director until Kirsten Davies confirmed
items.blurb: The administration's AI czar will temporarily lead the office coordinating federal cybersecurity policy.

items.title: Doctors who disagree with AI could face legal jeopardy
items.blurb: Mock juries sided more often with plaintiffs when an AI disagreed with a radiologist, raising liability pressure on doctors.

items.title: Nvidia shares rise in premarket trading while Anthropic is flat after major tech sell-off
items.blurb: Investors bought AI names at a discount after the Nasdaq's 10% weekly slide; Anthropic gave back early premarket gains.

items.title: Futures rally after Wall Street's nightmare week
items.blurb: Stock futures rebounded Monday after the worst tech week since 2020, driven by doubts over AI spending.

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, stocks rally
items.blurb: US stocks surged after Huang's return; the S&P 500 had fallen more than 9% since his Nov 12 departure.

items.title: CoreWeave, Oracle soar as Huang's return relieves Nvidia AI financing fears
items.blurb: Cloud firms that rely on Nvidia's financing backstops rebounded, with CoreWeave up 20% and Oracle up 12%.

items.title: SpaceX sued by Oregon and Virginia over AI deepfake porn, Grok safety claims
items.blurb: The first state lawsuits allege Grok enabled nonconsensual explicit images while SpaceX marketed it as safe.

items.title: The Download: AI's judgment problem and carbon removal's crop threat
items.blurb: A METR report finds models improve fast at coding but lag on tasks that need judgment.

items.title: S&P 500 futures rebound sharply to rise 2%, kick-starting shortened week after tech rout
items.blurb: Stock futures bounced Sunday evening after a week in which the AI sell-off erased the Nasdaq's 2026 gains.

items.title: Anthropic's record IPO collides with tech's worst week on Wall Street since 2020
items.blurb: Anthropic closed Friday at $88.91 after opening at $111.50, as the Nasdaq had its worst week since 2020.

items.title: From trash to treasure: Most hated stocks are winning as AI bull market rolls over
items.blurb: Investors are rotating out of AI leaders into long-shunned stocks as the AI trade loses momentum.

items.title: Isomorphic's $5b haul, Leo Pharma delays IPO, Lilly keeps shopping
items.blurb: AI drug-discovery company Isomorphic Labs raised $5 billion in a Series C round.

items.title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect
items.blurb: Cheap AI tools let attackers without expertise target small European businesses and connected devices that lack basic defenses.

items.title: "Psychologically, it is a mountain to climb." How AI fixes the fear of fundraising.
items.blurb: GoFundMe says its AI writing tools have been used over 100 million times and are on track to double projected fundraising help.

items.title: SoftBank suffers worst day in over two years as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks
items.blurb: SoftBank, a major OpenAI backer, fell about 14% as investors questioned returns on heavy AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall 6% in premarket amid AI selloff as Nvidia, AMD shares drop
items.blurb: A day after its record debut, Anthropic stock slipped with chipmakers as the broader AI trade stayed under pressure.

items.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need,' but analysts warn of volatility
items.blurb: Analysts see the listing as a test of public appetite for AI labs, but expect sharp swings in early trading.

items.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
items.blurb: Most developers now use AI coding tools, and some say faster output has cost the job part of its satisfaction.

items.title: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion total as underwriters scoop up 'greenshoe' overallotment
items.blurb: Underwriters bought 147 million extra shares at $83, lifting the record IPO's total to $93.5 billion.

items.title: Tech wreck drags Anthropic into the red on its second day of trading
items.blurb: A broad tech sell-off erased part of Anthropic's 17% first-day gain before Friday's open.

items.title: Anthropic defies the odds, holding record IPO despite 'massively disruptive' market
items.blurb: Anthropic went ahead with the largest IPO on record while AI chip stocks were falling sharply.
